Subject: Leveling + Local Market Scaling: proposal and benchmarking notes

Team — attaching the updated proposal and the geo benchmarking workbook (see attachments). This thread captures the asks we discussed in Friday's hiring review and the follow-ups from PeopleStaff. TL;DR: proposed anchor adjustments for EMEA and APAC, and a small realignment of Senior IC/Staff thresholds to reduce offer back-and-forth.

Key observations from benchmarking (summary):
- EMEA (UK/DE/FR): market anchors run ~+6–10% vs. current US anchors for E4–E6, driven by demand in infra/ML tags.
- APAC (SG/IN): mixed — SG ~+3% on senior roles, India shows ~-8% on median but fast upper-quartile growth.
- To keep offer cadence predictable, recommended we formalize a local market scaling multiplier and a narrow discretionary band for hiring managers (+/-6%).

Asks:
1) Review comp-band-proposal-v2.pdf and confirm anchor percent edits for E4/E5/E6 by Fri 22 Oct.
2) Approve temporary offer guardrails for recruiting (see sheet 'Offer Rules') that let TA surface offers within +/-6% without C-level signoff.
3) Confirm whether we want to add a stability buffer for open reqs older than 45 days (proposal: +4% flat uplift when reoffering).

PeopleStaff has provided candidate market comps in the workbook; Priya copied separately. I left a short note column with suggested anchor for each market. If we agree, I'll sync with Finance to reflect changes in the offer tool and update the hiring-runbook.

Attachments: 20261018-geo-bands-benchmark.xlsx (workbook), comp-band-proposal-v2.pdf (proposal with redlines).

--
Diego Fernandez
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Leveling + Local Market Scaling: proposal and benchmarking notes

Diego — thanks for pulling this together. Quick reads and a few decisions from my side: 

- Approve the EMEA anchor increases for E4 and E5 as proposed. For E6 (Staff) I want to hold off until we see two more closed comps from PeopleStaff (can be anonymized).
- Approve the +/-6% recruiter guardrail but require a written justification in Lever whenever a recruiter uses the discretionary allowance.
- I support the 45-day stability buffer with the +4% uplift but limit it to roles that have had no senior interview in last 21 days (prevents penalizing active searches).

Can Karthik and Vivek weigh in on whether Finance needs a phased rollout (i.e., pilot with NA/EMEA first then APAC)?

Thanks — quick finance read: the proposed EMEA uplifts for E4/E5 map to roughly a 1.8% uplift to overall hiring run-rate if we apply uniformly across open reqs. A few operational notes:

- Phase 1 (pilot): roll EMEA changes first for two quarters, monitor offer acceptance delta and ramp cost. If acceptance improves by >4% and churn remains flat, proceed to APAC.
- We need a short-term headcount collar for Budget Owners: allow +2 headcount flexibility per hiring manager for Q4 to accommodate market pressure (Finance will reconcile at month close).
- Please surface any reqs older than 60 days; those are most likely to require the +4% reoffer uplift. I attached a simple calculation I ran (sheet 'FinanceImpact' in the workbook).

All — good discussion. I approve the recommended EMEA anchor edits for E4/E5 and the +/-6% recruiter guardrail with the Lever justification requirement. Two follow-ups before we finalize: 

1) Diego — please produce a short pilot roll-out schedule (one-pager) with milestones (Finance sync, TA playbook update, Lever gating changes, comms to hiring managers) by next Tue 26 Oct. Put the schedule in the Drive link you provided and ping me when ready.
2) Marissa — when the pilot is live, ensure CS/EE teams get explicit offer-handling guidance for candidates relocated from EMEA -> US and vice versa (we've seen confusion in billing/relocation allowances).

Once Diego posts the roll-out sheet I will sign off formally and ask Legal to bake in a short clause for offer letters referencing locality adjustment rules.
